slides.sentence: With a quarter-point cut already [[priced in]], traders shrugged.
slides.meaning: Markets already expected it, so prices moved before the news, not after.

slides.sentence: The central bank lifted rates by 25 [[basis points]].
slides.meaning: One hundredth of a percentage point. 25 basis points = 0.25%.

slides.sentence: The [[yield curve]] stayed stubbornly inverted.
slides.meaning: Short-term bonds pay more than long-term ones, often read as a warning sign of recession.

slides.sentence: Analysts expect [[NIM]] to narrow next year.
slides.meaning: Net interest margin: what a bank earns on loans minus what it pays on deposits.

slides.sentence: The statement was a masterclass in [[forward guidance]].
slides.meaning: A central bank hinting at its future moves so markets can prepare.

slides.title: 5 words in [[every contract]] you sign.
slides.sub: Not legal advice. Just plain English.

slides.sentence: The vendor agrees to [[indemnify]] the customer against third-party claims.
slides.meaning: To cover someone's losses or legal costs if a certain problem happens.

slides.sentence: Neither party is liable for delays caused by [[force majeure]].
slides.meaning: Big events nobody controls, like disasters or wars, that excuse a delay.

slides.sentence: “[[Confidential Information]]” means any non-public information disclosed by either party.
slides.meaning: Whatever this contract says it is. Glossa reads the definition on the page.

slides.sentence: This agreement includes a [[severability]] clause.
slides.meaning: If one part is struck down, the rest of the contract still stands.

slides.sentence: The [[governing law]] of this agreement is Delaware.
slides.meaning: Which place's laws are used to interpret the contract.

posts.caption:
Leases, job offers, terms of service: the words are always the same, and almost nobody explains them.

Save this, and next time select the clause and let Glossa explain it in plain English. If the contract defines a word itself, Glossa uses that definition.

Not legal advice, just less confusion.
